distinctness.from_BNB_stacked_reward_hedge: this candidate uses only an already_held supported stablecoin and needs no BNB acquisition perpetual hedge funding basis margin or liquidation exposure
distinctness.from_idle_stablecoin_simple_earn: Launchpool distributes a separate new project token during a bounded campaign and competes with the stablecoin's alternative yield and liquidity use

economic_gate.accepted_scope_if_proved: incremental reward only on an independently already_held eligible supported stablecoin balance that is idle for the entire chosen interval and not needed for orders margin collateral withdrawals or prompt liquidity
economic_gate.principal_rule: never acquire swap retain borrow or redirect a stablecoin for Launchpool; use the lower timestamp_proved idle owned balance across the complete accrual interval
economic_gate.reward_valuation_rule: value only owned distributed reward quantity at contemporaneous executable displayed bids available after distribution with exact sale fees size and settlement; announcement allocation APY future high or later close is not value evidence
economic_gate.strict_positive_gate: every admitted interval and aggregate must remain strictly positive in the exact principal unit after all costs; zero or missing reward price rejects
economic_gate.withdrawal_liquidity_rule: early unlock language is not a latency guarantee; measure actual account unlock availability and exclude principal required inside the observed worst release delay

limitations: No active or upcoming Launchpool project was source-proved on 2026-08-26; the direct current page returned WAF-empty HTTP 202.
No KYC region account eligibility pool cap user allocation total locked balance estimated APY lock state reward row or Spot payout was accessed.
The generic guide's no-additional-cost phrasing does not include forfeited alternative yield liquidity delay reward-token sale friction tax custody or operations.
A new project token can be illiquid volatile delisted restricted or worth zero by distribution time; token quantity alone is not profit.
USDC FDUSD U and USD1 are not assumed interchangeable or worth one another; every cost and reward must be converted executably into the exact principal asset.
The two-day OPN farming example began on 2026-03-03 and is historical; its exact end timestamp is not stated in the retained source and it cannot be treated as a current or repeated campaign.

retry_policy.public_trigger: a new official active_or_upcoming Launchpool announcement with its own supported stablecoin pool exact farming window reward allocation eligibility and listing_or_distribution terms
retry_policy.read_only_account_trigger: both designated ephemeral Binance mainnet credentials plus explicit GET_only account evidence authority after the public trigger
retry_policy.separate_mutation_and_trading_authority_: every lock unlock subscription redemption transfer conversion or reward sale
